brief_rule.character_aliases: P1..Pn in first-appearance order; replace names inside retained text fields

control_generation.order: sample freeze -> Control generation -> Control SHA seal -> selector profiling
requirements: preserve plausible character/social texture rather than maximizing compression

evaluation.pair_masking: After generation seal, deterministic SHA-based A/B swap per scene; evaluator receives scene brief + masked pair, not policy decision.
evaluation.pair_result_rule: Treatment win if craft mean >= Control mean +0.30 and no critical/protection failure; Control win if Control mean >= Treatment mean +0.30 or Treatment has protection failure; otherwise Tie.
evaluation.same_model_limitation: If no independent judge is available, evaluation is stronger-virtual same-model blind-masked and claim remains virtual/preformal.

frozen_input_rule.candidate_r3: May protect claim/evidence classification only; cannot be treated as active semantic engine.
frozen_input_rule.data: Frozen DB59 only; use canonical runtime_scene_projection records. Do not read original_extracted/source prose for selection, generation, or evaluation.
frozen_input_rule.engine_contract: P07-I4D LiterarySurfaceContractR1 + SurfaceRealizationModeR1 as parent baseline; I4H is experimental policy only.

hypothesis.h_physicalizable_subtext: Some relational scenes with latent subtext can improve under LOW physicalization without deleting character-bearing dialogue or social texture.
hypothesis.null: Eligible interventions do not produce reliable craft gains, or gains require unacceptable voice/social/fidelity harm.
hypothesis.primary: For fresh DB59-derived scene briefs, a conservative I4H policy that chooses ABSTAIN first, applies a reliability gate, and uses LOW/STANDARD only when eligible will improve craft on intervened scenes while keeping harmful-intervention rate low and preserving voice/social texture.

pass_hold_fail_criteria.fail: safety/fidelity breach or harmful-intervention rate above frozen threshold
pass_hold_fail_criteria.hold: ambiguous craft, insufficient interventions, or same-model evidence judged insufficient for promotion despite numerical pass
pass_hold_fail_criteria.overall_pass: all hard gates + sample power + nonloss + win-rate + harmful-rate + voice/social guard. PASS grants eligibility for I4H development physical synchronization only; no authority changes until new 5-Part/9-Package seal and audit.
pass_hold_fail_criteria.physicalizable_subtext_gate: if >=3 LOW scenes have physicalizable_subtext>=2, at least 2/3 must be nonloss and none may have >1.0 voice/social drop; otherwise hypothesis remains unresolved
pass_hold_fail_criteria.sample_power: at least 6 interventions required for a craft PASS; otherwise HOLD_SAMPLE_POWER
pass_hold_fail_criteria.voice_social_guard: mean change on voice_specificity >= -0.25 and no intervention scene drop >1.0 on voice_specificity attributable to compression; violations => HOLD/FAIL

purpose: Qualify or reject I4H craft behavior prospectively. This is not a test of OpenAI Live parity, human-writer equivalence, Production promotion, CP1 closure, whole-episode competitiveness, or Formal R140.
reliability_hard_gates: LOW/STANDARD length and dialogue-retention bounds pass unless predeclared mechanical parser false-positive is adjudicated without changing bytes
research_questions: Can the selector abstain on already-playable or voice/socially protected Control scenes?
Among selected interventions, is Treatment non-inferior or better without semantic/speaker/source violations?
Does LOW physicalization improve latent subtext while retaining character-bearing dialogue and social texture?
Does STANDARD improve information/action economy only where protection risk is low?
What is the harmful-intervention rate under a prospective freeze-before-treatment design?

INFO_CHALLENGE.description: remaining works; REVEAL or STATE_CHANGE info context plus opposition or >=2 functional propositions

NATURAL.description: one scene per work from eligible canonical runtime records, selected by lowest deterministic SHA256 rank

RELATIONAL_SUBTEXT.description: remaining works; exactly 2 characters, STATE_CHANGE context, no OPPOSITION participation, secondary POV or both characters PRIMARY

global_eligibility: work belongs to frozen canonical work list from current planner-runtime authority
at most one selected scene per work across all cohorts
sample_rule.no_posthoc_replacement: If a cohort cannot fill its quota under frozen rules, status becomes HOLD_SAMPLE_POWER; do not relax predicates after seeing content.

decision_rule: ABSTAIN if max(social_texture,voice_specificity)>=3 and exposition_risk<=2 unless physicalizable_subtext==3 and proposed edit is additive LOW
STANDARD if exposition_risk>=2 and procedural_pressure>=2 and max(social_texture,voice_specificity)<=1 and already_playable<=1
LOW if physicalizable_subtext>=2 or exposition_risk>=2, provided STANDARD rule is not met

definitions.already_playable: degree to which scene already works through filmable action, reaction, beat turn, and spatial behavior
definitions.exposition_risk: degree to which dialogue redundantly explains plot/emotion/relationship that could be carried by action/subtext
definitions.physicalizable_subtext: degree of latent relational meaning that can be added as playable behavior without deleting character-bearing dialogue
definitions.procedural_pressure: degree of operational/deadline/decision pressure that benefits from action-linked economy
definitions.social_texture: degree to which dialogue carries lived relation, humor, status negotiation, intimacy, or ensemble rhythm
definitions.voice_specificity: degree of character-specific speech behavior that would be harmed by compression

selector_profile_after_control_before_tr.freeze_requirement: profile values, decision, and rationale SHA-sealed before any Treatment prose is generated

state_change_policy.after_hold_or_fail: retain P07-I4D authority; log result; redesign only via new preregistration
state_change_policy.after_pass: first build and audit a new 5-Part/9-Package physical sync; only then may I4H become development authority and only then may I4I start
state_change_policy.during_experiment: formal_count unchanged; Production unchanged; Active Development Engine remains P07-I4D; R140 stays 0/0/0

LOW: do not delete character-bearing dialogue merely to shorten
dialogue characters should remain >=75% of Control unless exact redundant restatement is removed
STANDARD: may restructure action/dialogue for information economy
preserve all character-specific/socially functional speech needed for voice/status/ethics
dialogue characters should remain >=55% of Control
common: no new named entity except neutral props already implied
